REM BadUSB MSC - Example: Windows to Flipper
REM Creates FLIPTEST.TXT on the Desktop and moves it to BADUSBMSC.
REM Use only on a PC you own or are allowed to test.
REM Select the keyboard layout matching Windows first.
DELAY 2000
GUI r
DELAY 700
STRING powershell -NoProfile
ENTER
DELAY 1800
REM Find the Windows Desktop
STRING $desk=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')
ENTER
DELAY 300
REM Create a harmless test file
STRING Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $desk 'FLIPTEST.TXT') -Value 'Hello from Windows! BadUSB MSC transfer test.' -Encoding ASCII
ENTER
DELAY 500
REM Find the BADUSBMSC volume
STRING $v=Get-Volume -FileSystemLabel BADUSBMSC -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
ENTER
DELAY 700
REM Move the file to BADUSBMSC only when the drive is available
STRING if($v -and $v.DriveLetter){Move-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $desk 'FLIPTEST.TXT') -Destination ($v.DriveLetter+':\FLIPTEST.TXT') -ErrorAction Stop;Write-Host 'PC to Flipper OK'}else{Write-Host 'BADUSBMSC not found'}
ENTER
